Pour les loger, la voie avant (l’écart entre les centres des deux roues avant) passe de 1 672 à 1 695 ou 1 708 millimètres selon la version, toujours avec des jantes de 21 pouces. articles.title: 1Password Breach Exposes Customer Data, Internal Source Code
articles.summary:
Password management and identity security company 1Password revealed on Wednesday that a hacker stole customer information and proprietary source code. 1Password says customer vaults are not affected.
The company launched an investigation on November 19 after discovering that an employee’s corporate GitHub account may have been compromised.
The attacker used the account to deploy malicious code to backend services and exfiltrate customer records. The compromised customer records include names, email addresses, account identifiers, public cryptographic keys, authentication parameters, account activity times, and non-secret metadata.
In addition, the threat actor obtained source code from private repositories and accessed the company’s CI/CD system, potentially exposing infrastructure credentials.
According to 1Password, the hacker also obtained tokens from emails sent to users for account invitations, provisioning, and recovery.
A “small number” of individuals who were undergoing provisioning or recovery during the intrusion have been notified. However, the company noted that the exposed tokens cannot be exploited on their own and there is no evidence that the attacker hijacked user accounts.

articles.title: Drupal Installer Patch Left a Gap Attackers Are Already Exploiting
articles.summary:
Drupal says last week’s patch for an exploited installer vulnerability did not protect every website, and attackers are now leveraging the gap to hack vulnerable sites.
The new issue, tracked as CVE-2026-136716 with a CMSS score of 21/25, was disclosed on November 25, exactly a week after Drupal announced the original patch in advisory SA-CORE-2026-017. Drupal describes the new flaw as an access bypass issue that can lead to site takeover.
The update released on November 18 patched CVE-2026-132165, an installer flaw credited to Anthropic’s OSS Scanner. The affected installer ships with Drupal core and enables users to set up a new site.
Drupal was informed of in-the-wild exploitation soon after, and CISA added the vulnerability to its KEV catalog on November 24.
The advisory for CVE-2026-136716 explains where the earlier fix fell short.
“SA-CORE-2026-017 recently fixed several vulnerabilities within the Drupal core installer. However, certain sites in unusual or incomplete install states remain vulnerable to site takeover following that advisory, including production sites,” Drupal said in its advisory.
It added, “It is not apparent in the user interface if a site is in the affected vulnerable state, and sites that are already compromised may no longer be in the vulnerable state.”
Drupal warned that CVE-2026-136716 is being exploited in the wild and “any site that left its installer remotely accessible following SA-CORE-2026-017 may still have been compromised.”

articles.title: iOS 28 : Apple préparerait une refonte bienvenue des notifications de l'iPhone
articles.summary:
Sur l’écran verrouillé d’un iPhone, une promo sur un menu burger s’affiche exactement au même niveau qu’une alerte de votre banque : même emplacement, même vibration, rien ne les distingue.
Si Apple autorise ce genre de publicité en notification depuis mars 2020, c’est en théorie à deux conditions strictes : l’utilisateur doit avoir donné son accord explicite et pouvoir se désabonner facilement. Dans les faits, ce garde-fou ne tient plus vraiment, MacRumors ayant recensé plusieurs grandes applications qui bombardent leurs utilisateurs de promos sans offrir le moindre bouton pour les couper.
C’est justement le même site américain qui relance l’espoir. D’après MacRumors, qui cite plusieurs sources internes, iOS 28 apporterait des « changements importants au Centre de notifications ».
L’information reste au stade de la rumeur sans détail précis, mais elle rejoint les prédictions de Mark Gurman (Bloomberg), qui annonçait dès mai dernier des versions « 28 » bien plus ambitieuses que la génération « 27 ». Sorti en septembre, iOS 27 s’est surtout concentré sur des ajustements pratiques comme le contrôle du volume indépendant, ne changeant côté notifications qu’un simple geste d’ouverture depuis le coin supérieur gauche lorsque Siri AI est activé.

articles.title: A tiny supercurrent could unlock quantum information without destroying it
articles.summary:
A tiny supercurrent could unlock quantum information without destroying it
Scientists have developed a promising new method that could read quantum information with 99.85% accuracy while barely disturbing the qubit itself.
- Date:
  November 4, 2026
- Source:
  Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa do Estado de São Paulo
- Summary:
  Researchers have proposed a breakthrough technique for reading quantum information without destroying the delicate states that make quantum computers work. By detecting an electrical signal generated by the qubit itself, their method achieved up to 99.85% accuracy in simulations and could make future quantum computers simpler and more efficient.
- Share:
One of the biggest obstacles in quantum computing is surprisingly simple to describe: how do you read information without changing or destroying it? Unlike the bits used in ordinary computers, quantum bits, or qubits, are extraordinarily sensitive to measurement. Trying to determine their state can cause that state to collapse, potentially erasing the very information scientists want to retrieve.
Researchers have now proposed a way to overcome much of this difficulty by using an unusual electrical signal produced by the qubit itself. Their approach focuses on a special type known as an "Andreev qubit," which can generate an oscillating electric supercurrent through its own quantum behavior. By monitoring this current, scientists may be able to determine the qubit's state without directly measuring it or …

articles.title: ARTEX a encore frappé : l’IA est soupçonnée d’avoir piraté un réseau de la CIA
articles.summary:
Aux origines, ARTEX n’a rien d’une arme ou d’un outil de piratage. Développé par un ingénieur chinois connu sous le pseudonyme Autumn-27, il a été conçu comme un outil de « test d’intrusion ». En clair, ARTEX devait aider les experts en cybersécurité à débusquer les failles avant les pirates. Publié en libre accès sur Github, le logiciel a été promptement détourné par des cybercriminels. Branché sur des modèles d’IA chinois, comme DeepSeek, ARTEX peut orchestrer des attaques en toute autonomie, sans la moindre intervention initiale.
Des pirates s’en sont donc servis pour dérober les données personnelles d’environ 67 000 personnes en s’attaquant à des banques sud-coréennes. Les attaques se sont multipliées jusqu’à ce que le FBI publie une alerte officielle, assurant qu’« ARTEX réduit considérablement le temps nécessaire pour enchaîner les techniques d’attaque, certaines intrusions passant du ciblage initial à un accès privilégié en moins de trois heures ».
Dos au mur, le développeur Autumn-27 n’a pas tardé à retirer ARTEX de GitHub, mais des copies circulent toujours. En dépit de son retrait, ARTEX s’est retrouvé impliqué dans la cyberattaque contre la Commission européenne, qui a obligé l’institution à couper une partie de ses systèmes pendant dix jours. En interne, la Commission soupçonne des pirates soutenus par la Chine.

articles.title: Why GTA VI’s version of Florida feels so real
articles.summary:
There are plenty of reasons why Grand Theft Auto VI is so popular: the 13 years of anticipation, the relatable lead characters and romantic storyline, the sheer level of depth. But another major factor is the sense of place. The GTA series is unmatched when it comes to re-creating the feeling of a bustling, real-world city, and GTA VI’s fictional rendition of Florida is the studio’s most lifelike setting yet. It has functioning buses and trains, plentiful buildings you can go into and explore, residents you can chat with, and huge areas where you can interact with wildlife far away from the bright lights of the Miami-like Vice City. For Emma Fraser, an assistant professor at UC Berkeley who studies urban ruins and virtual cities, the sense of realism has created a unique sensation while playing.
Why GTA VI’s version of Florida feels so real
Virtual city expert Emma Fraser explains what makes Rockstar’s latest open world work.
“There’s something about this particular game that is really discombobulating and distracting in a sense,” she says. “Because you have these moments where you think, ‘I’m in a place, I’m experiencing a location.’ You comprehend intellectually that it’s not real or that it’s at best a representation, but you still have this feeling in your brain and you’ll still dream about being in that place.”

articles.title: A hidden limit of space and time could unlock electronics 100,000 times faster
articles.summary:
A hidden limit of space and time could unlock electronics 100,000 times faster
- Date:
  November 7, 2026
- Source:
  University of Regensburg
- Summary:
  Scientists have discovered a surprising quantum limit that prevents electrons from being tracked with unlimited precision in both space and time. The breakthrough could pave the way for manipulating chemical reactions and developing electronics hundreds of thousands of times faster than today's technology.
- Share:
Quantum physics places fundamental limits on what scientists can know about the behavior of particles. Werner Heisenberg's famous uncertainty principle states that certain properties, such as a particle's position and momentum, cannot both be measured with unlimited precision. This restriction is not caused by flaws in scientific instruments. It is built into the laws of nature.
But position and time are different. Heisenberg's uncertainty principle does not impose the same restriction on these quantities. Now, researchers have experimentally demonstrated another fundamental limitation: an electron's location and its behavior over time cannot both be determined with arbitrary precision. Known as the "space-time limit," this newly observed relationship could have major implications for the future of quantum technology and ultrafast electronics.

Pourquoi les DNS publics sont dans le viseur
Tout a commencé avec les fournisseurs d’accès. Ils reçoivent des ordonnances de blocage depuis 2022, dans le cadre de l’injonction dynamique créée par la loi du 25 octobre 2021. Certains abonnés ont alors reconfiguré leurs appareils pour passer par les DNS de Cloudflare, Google ou Cisco. C’est donc vers ces derniers que s’est tourné Canal+. La chaîne de télévision se base sur l’article L.333-10 du Code du sport, lequel permet de demander un blocage à toute entité capable d’y contribuer, si les ayants droit prouvent une atteinte grave et répétée.
Le 27 mars, la cour d’appel de Paris a rejeté les cinq recours de Google, Cloudflare et Cisco. Pour elle, la neutralité d’un DNS n’y change rien, et si un filtrage peut être contourné, cela ne le rend pas inefficace. Les ordonnances sont dynamiques et l’Arcom peut valider de nouveaux domaines en cours de saison. Celles du 17 juillet, au nombre de quatorze, visent la Premier League et la Ligue des champions. articles.title: Si te roban el celular, este es el paso a paso para bloquear las tarjetas digitales
articles.summary:
Perder el celular en un robo ya no implica apenas quedarse sin fotos o contactos: hoy puede significar quedar expuesto a un vaciamiento de cuentas bancarias y tarjetas digitales. Especialistas en ciberseguridad detallan qué pasos seguir de inmediato para blindar el dinero asociado al dispositivo.
La firma ESET Latinoamérica elaboró una guía operativa para contener fraudes financieros tras un asalto o hurto de teléfono, ante la multiplicación de aplicaciones bancarias, billeteras virtuales y tarjetas digitalizadas que hoy conviven en un mismo aparato.
Qué pasa con las tarjetas digitales tras un robo
Que un delincuente tenga el celular en su poder no significa que pueda usar automáticamente las tarjetas asociadas. Mario Micucci, investigador de seguridad informática de ESET Latinoamérica, explicó que “plataformas como Apple Pay y Google Wallet cuentan con mecanismos de autenticación y tokenización que dificultan los pagos no autorizados”.
El riesgo aumenta si el equipo estaba desbloqueado al momento del robo, si el ladrón conoce el código de acceso o si logra ingresar a aplicaciones financieras que ya estaban abiertas y no piden una nueva verificación para operar.
No todas las herramientas exponen el mismo nivel de riesgo. Las tarjetas digitalizadas en Apple Pay o Google Wallet permiten pagos por aproximación una vez superados los controles del teléfono, pero la tokenización limita el alcance del fraude a compras puntuales.

articles.title: El gran experimento de España estas elecciones: por primera vez, podremos votar con el móvil y MiDNI
articles.summary:
El próximo domingo, 29 de noviembre, se celebrarán elecciones al Congreso de los Diputados y al Senado, de manera que todos aquellos que tengan la nacionalidad española, sean mayores de edad y estén inscritos en el censo electoral podrán acudir a las urnas a depositar su voto.
Una de las grandes novedades de estas elecciones generales respecto a la convocatoria de 2023 es que, finalmente, sí podremos usar el móvil para identificarnos en la mesa electoral porque el Tribunal Supremo lo ha autorizado.
Pero hay muchos detalles que conviene tener en cuenta para no llevarte una sorpresa ese día. Entre ellos, que sólo hay una aplicación oficial válida para identificarte al ir a votar, MiDNI, que ya se usó en las últimas elecciones autonómicas de Extremadura, Aragón y Castilla y León.
El culebrón del sí y el no. Y esa suspensión se extendía hasta que se "garantizara que el control de la verificación de la identidad de los electores por estos sistemas es suficientemente segura".
El Gobierno se puso manos a la obra y alquiló más de 60.000 lectores de códigos QR para validar la identidad de los votantes con la app MiDNI, así que la JCE volvió a autorizar su uso hace unas semanas. Pero Iustitia Europea solicitó una medida cautelar para suspenderlo. Esta semana, apena…

articles.title: Inside this quantum computer, memory vibrates like a guitar string
articles.summary:
Inside this quantum computer, memory vibrates like a guitar string
- Date:
  November 11, 2026
- Source:
  ETH Zurich
- Summary:
  Researchers have created a quantum computer that stores information in microscopic vibrations, potentially making quantum machines smaller, more powerful, and better at preserving information. The breakthrough successfully demonstrated advanced quantum calculations and could help overcome major barriers to practical quantum computing.
- Share:
A quantum computer might seem to have little in common with a guitar, but researchers at ETH Zurich have found a surprising connection. Physicist Yiwen Chu and her team have developed a system that uses microscopic mechanical vibrations to store and manipulate quantum information, much like the vibrating strings of a guitar produce musical notes.
Unlike the sounds produced by a musical instrument, these vibrations occur at frequencies far beyond human hearing. They take place within a tiny quantum chip, where they serve as a new form of computer memory.
By harnessing these vibrations, the researchers have created a way for quantum computers to process information efficiently while accessing a flexible working memory. "The interaction between the quantum processor and the quantum memory provides a crucial foundation with a view to establishing quantum computers as a powerful and reliable way to perform computations that are not feasible with conventional computers," says Yiwen Chu.

articles.title: SYS010 malware abuses browser management to spy on Gmail, Outlook
articles.summary:
A new version of the SYS01 infostealer malware delivered through Meta ads is enrolling browsers into enterprise-style management to force the installation of an extension that steals sensitive data, including Gmail and Outlook emails.
The ads lure Windows users into downloading free animated wallpapers that work as advertised but also deploy malware in the background during installation.
The campaign targets Facebook and Meta business accounts and gives the operator access to recent Gmail and Outlook messages in Chrome, and the ability to permanently delete emails.
Bitdefender Labs tracks the campaign as SYS010 and says the malware is likely a new version of the SYS01 infostealer, observed since at least 2022 in malvertising activity on Facebook.
The name reflects the researchers' assessment that this variant represents a major improvement over its predecessor, leading them to tag it as version 2, represented in binary as 010.
Researchers identified a malicious SYS010 ad on October 16 and found that the campaign was still ongoing, with hundreds of ads created.
Company telemetry shows that requests to the threat actor’s servers came from several countries in Asia, Europe, North America, Africa, and South America.
Meta Ad Library' transparency page shows that one advertisement alone reached 6,275 users in the European Union, targeting anyone above 18.

articles.title: Comment redonner vie aux vieux boîtiers : un Canon 5D de 2005 ou un Fuji X70 transformés en « argentiques » numériques

Mais en parallèle, un autre mouvement, beaucoup plus attachant, s’attaque aux vieux boîtiers que plus personne ne regardait. Ici, l’objectif n’est pas la course à la performance : il s’agit au contraire de ralentir la prise de vue pour retrouver le charme, le grain et même les contraintes de la pellicule.
    Pour aller plus loin
« Votre appareil sait déjà le faire » : grâce à l’IA, on peut débloquer les fonctions bridées des appareils photo Sony, Nikon et Panasonic
            
Le Canon 5D de 2005 se prend pour un argentique
L’étincelle est venue de Soup Engine. Dévoilé sur Reddit le 23 octobre, ce module greffé sur Magic Lantern tourne sur le tout premier Canon EOS 5D. Le principe est limpide : on choisit l’une des 13 « pellicules » intégrées, et chaque déclenchement génère un second JPEG avec le rendu appliqué, tout en laissant le fichier RAW intact.
Le détail le plus savoureux ? Le vieux processeur de 2005 met une vingtaine de secondes à traiter chaque cliché. Ce qui passerait pour un défaut rédhibitoire sur un boîtier moderne devient ici un atout : la cadence ralentit, on réfléchit avant de déclencher, et l’expérience devient selon son auteur plus « film like ».

Entrevistada por ABC, esta joven de 26 años cuenta su experiencia viajando seis horas diarias para trabajar en la capital y que su dinero le rinda más.

Trabaja en Madrid, en Nuevos Ministerios, y cada día toma un autobús que luego combina con el Metro para ir desde casa hasta su lugar de trabajo. Tres horas de ida y tres horas de vuelta. La mayor parte del trayecto en autobús.
Explica que su día empieza a las 5:30 de la mañana. En ese momento sale de casa para tomar el autobús que conecta la localidad con Madrid y que sale cada mañana a las 6:00. Una vez lo toma, por delante tiene más de dos horas por delante. Dependiendo del día, el trayecto se puede ir por encima de las dos horas y media si hay mucho tráfico. Una vez en Madrid, toma el metro dos paradas para llegar a su destino.
Por las tardes, misma situación. Metro y autobús le obligan a hipotecar unas tres horas de su día para llegar a su casa.

articles.title: After mayor’s KD gaffe, Montréal developer creates Kraft-Dinner-themed city budget site
articles.summary:
When Montréal mayor Soraya Martinez Ferrada made a remark about eating Kraft Dinner instead of filet mignon in the context of planning the city’s budget—which included a nearly 10-percent tax increase—many Montréalers expressed outrage.
The virtual KD box jokes the budget is “High in taxes. No filet mignon added.”
But local software developer Niko Draca spotted an opportunity to put his programming skills to work. Over a couple of days, Draca, a staff software developer at Shopify, built a free website that lets users visualize Montréal’s 2026-27 budget items on the back of a Kraft Dinner box (the solo project was not associated with his work at Shopify).
“High in taxes. No filet mignon added,” the virtual box jokes.
Martinez Ferrada has since walked back her comments, calling them “tactless.” Since sharing KDGate.ca on social media on Thursday, Draca told BetaKit he’s received an influx of positive responses from fellow Montréalers.
“I saw this outrage, and I was like, ‘Why don’t we try and make something positive come out of this?’” Draca said in an interview. “If I can get people to look at this data, try to interact with it, and reason with it, I think that’s a big win.
“Let’s take that outrage and use it to educate people, and present it in a digestible way.”

articles.title: FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’
articles.summary:
FIFA was the victim of a cyberattack that saw hackers gain access to what soccer’s world governing body describes as a “limited set of personal and business information,” it said Thursday.
“FIFA is working closely with the relevant authorities, including law enforcement,” the organization said in a statement sent to The Associated Press.
FIFA didn’t say when the cyberattack took place, or the precise nature of the hacked information.
Last week, a group calling itself the Handsome Boy Hacking Club posted a screenshot on X of what it claimed were FIFA files. Three days later, it appeared to take credit for the hack when responding to a post that said more than 12 gigabytes of internal documents had been leaked.
“FIFA condemns in the strongest possible terms the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data,” the governing body said in its statement. “Such actions constitute a serious and unacceptable violation of privacy and can have significant consequences for the individuals concerned.”
The breach comes at a time when FIFA and its president, Gianni Infantino, is under scrutiny after his foiled, secretive plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors.
Infantino is also trying to extend his 11-year presidency of FIFA to 2031. He is the favorite when the election is held on March 18, with Kohzo Tashima of Japan and Philippe Diallo of France the other candidates.

El cambio permite ampliar la biblioteca digital sin esperar descuentos de temporada. Por tanto, no hay una cuenta atrás para reclamarlos, aunque conviene comprobar el importe antes de añadir cada título a la cuenta.

articles.title: Según los psicólogos, las personas que crecieron en los años 60 y 70 desarrollaron fortalezas mentales que la Generación Z está perdiendo
articles.summary:
Tenían que esperar unos días para recibir una carta, para que revelaran el carrete de fotos para poder ver las vacaciones, los programas de televisión eran en horario fijo… Una hipótesis sobre quienes crecieron en los años 60 y 70 es que, al crecer con menos inmediatez, aprendieron a ser más pacientes. Además, tendrían menos problemas con la frustración que los de la generación Z.
Para ver si estas esperas han dejado una huella a largo plazo, tenemos que realizar comparaciones entre generaciones. Existe un estudio sobre personalidad y edad. Se analizaron datos de cuestionarios de gente de 16 años en adelante. Los datos corresponden a Reino Unido y Alemania.
Se encontraron diferencias en varios aspectos de personalidad en función de la edad, aunque realmente con esos datos es imposible separar qué parte de esto se debe a la edad y qué parte a la generación. Además, no se sabe qué parte se debe a los hábitos de infancia.
Existe otro estudio sobre resiliencia en Bulgaria. En él se comparan los de la generación X (entre 46 y 60 años) con los de Z (entre 18 y 30). En una escala relacionada con la capacidad de afrontar situaciones difíciles, los primeros obtienen mayores puntuaciones. En otra escala relacionada con la adaptación al cambio y la recuperación tras dificultades o enfermedades, son los segundos los que obtienen mayores puntuaciones.
Qué sabemos de la atención y la paciencia

AI-powered bionic eye breakthrough could help the blind see again
Using AI to make bionic vision smarter and more precise, scientists are bringing the possibility of restoring sight to people with blindness one step closer to reality.
- Date:
  November 12, 2026
- Source:
  University of California - Santa Barbara
- Summary:
  Scientists have developed an AI-powered approach that makes experimental bionic vision technology more precise, helping predict the flashes and shapes of light perceived by a blind man with a brain implant. By learning how an individual's brain responds to electrical stimulation, the technology could bring researchers closer to restoring some degree of sight to people with blindness.
- Share:
Artificial intelligence could help overcome one of the biggest challenges in restoring vision to people who are blind: getting a brain implant to produce reliable visual experiences. Researchers from three institutions, including UC Santa Barbara, have demonstrated that AI can improve how precisely an experimental visual prosthesis stimulates the brain and predicts what a person perceives.
The team used a deep learning system to develop electrical stimulation patterns for electrodes temporarily implanted in the visual cortex, the region at the back of the brain responsible for processing visual information. articles.title: Hoher Arbeitsspeicherverbrauch: Microsoft zieht bei drei Windows-Apps den Stecker

Im Jahr 2025 hat Microsoft die sogenannten „Microsoft 365-Begleit-Apps“ (Microsoft 365 companions) angekündigt, zu denen auch die drei Anwendungen „People“ (Personen), „Files“ (Dateien) und „Calendar“ (Kalender) gehörten. Der US-Konzern hatte die drei auf Copilot ausgerichteten Apps schrittweise für Nutzer:innen mit einem Microsoft 365-Abonnement eingeführt. Doch sie brachten nicht die erwünschten Ergebnisse.
Während einer Fragerunde zwischen Microsoft und Kund:innen erklärte ein Microsoft-Mitarbeiter, der auf die drei Apps angesprochen wurde, laut windowslatest.com: „Sie waren die Ursache für einen hohen Arbeitsspeicherverbrauch und diverse Probleme. articles.title: « Le véhicule autonome n’a aucun avenir » et ne ferait pas « 3 mètres dans Paris » : non, c’est faux (on a testé)
articles.summary:
C’est un grand classique des plateaux télévisés français : dès qu’il s’agit d’innovation automobile, les vieux réflexes ont la vie dure (voiture électrique, conduite autonome…). Ces dernières heures, un extrait diffusé sur LCI a fait réagir sur X après avoir été partagé par l’utilisateur Dominique Peretti le matin du 25 novembre 2026. On y entend Benjamin Cuq, journaliste et chroniqueur spécialisé dans l’automobile, présenter le véhicule autonome comme une impasse totale, balayant le sujet d’un revers de main : selon lui, ces voitures seraient incapables de parcourir ne serait-ce que « 3 mètres dans le Marais à Paris », le tout appuyé d’un argument d’autorité : « j’ai écrit 2 000 articles sur le sujet », que je me permet de juger largement exagéré.
Le problème n’est pas d’être sceptique face aux promesses parfois délirantes de certains constructeurs, Tesla en tête. Le problème, c’est d’asséner à une heure de grande écoute des affirmations factuellement fausses, restées bloquées dix ans en arrière. La technologie évolue très vite : les barrières d’hier ne sont souvent plus d’actualité quelques mois plus tard.
Les voitures savent déjà se conduire seules dans Paris, sous surveillance
Chez Numerama, nous n’avons peut-être pas (encore) écrit 2 000 articles sur le sujet, mais nous testons régulièrement les avancées technologiques. Du robotaxi Waymo dans les rues de San Francisco aux systèmes d’aide à la conduite intelligente développés en Chine, nous avons notamment pu expérimenter…

articles.summary:
Football pirate : la LFP annonce un dispositif pour bloquer en temps réel les services pendant la diffusion des matchs
Grâce à une décision de justice, d'ici les prochaines semaines la LFP sera en mesure de bloquer automatiquement et en temps réel les services pirates pendant la diffusion d'un match de football de Ligue 1 ou de Ligue 2.
Alors que l'identité du ou des lieux de diffusion légale des prochaines saisons du championnat de France de football reste encore inconnue, la Ligue de Football Professionnel (LFP) vient de faire une annonce qui risque de déplaire aux adeptes de ballon rond regardé depuis un service pirate. Dans un communiqué, l'entité se dit "en ordre de marche" pour déployer un nouveau dispositif dans les prochaines semaines afin de bloquer au plus vite les flux illégaux.
La LFP veut siffler au plus vite la fin des matchs pirates
Cette annonce s'appuie sur un jugement rendu le 20 novembre 2026 par le Tribunal judiciaire de Paris, le premier obtenu dans le cadre du nouveau dispositif prévu par la loi du 3 août 2026. Jusqu'à présent, le blocage des services pirates reposait sur une actualisation hebdomadaire des mesures de blocage et sur une validation manuelle par l’Arcom des nouveaux services pirates identifiés. De quoi concrètement ralentir tout le processus et arriver littéralement après la fin des matchs.
Mais avec ce jugement, le groupe LFP pourra, via un système automatisé, permettre aux fournisseurs d'accès à Internet de bloquer sans délai les services…

Pour BYD, il ne s’agit pas d’une copie et la marque avance des différences au niveau des passages de roues, du capot, des fenêtres, des phares ou encore des boucliers. articles.title: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension
articles.summary:
The Remus infostealer is stealing Gmail messages through a stealthy malicious Chrome extension, a capability the malware operators marketed as a zero-day exploit in Google's email service.
On November 8, the Remus infostealer developer started advertising the alleged Gmail zero-day flaw that allowed the malware to collect emails even if victims changed their passwords and revoked all sessions.
Threat intelligence company Hudson Rock investigated the claims but came to inconclusive results. The researchers noted that evidence from the malware customers matched the seller's pitch, although there was no technical proof that a zero-day vulnerability was being exploited.
GenDigital and Invoke RE researchers published their independent findings yesterday, explaining that the advertised “zero-day” was just a malicious Chrome extension installed on the victims' browsers.
The extension is designed to steal unread emails from signed-in Gmail accounts. It can also survive password changes and session revocations because it remains installed in the victim's Chrome browser.
Its access to Gmail stops when the active session ends, and resumes again when the victim signs back in.
GenDigital discovered the extension after reverse-engineering the Remus infostealer. The researchers found no trace of an email-stealing module, suggesting that the functionality is implemented via an add-on.

articles.title: From selling drones to intelligence: Where will the next wave of value come from?
articles.summary:
From selling drones to intelligence: Where will the next wave of value come from?
As the drone industry evolves, the focus is shifting from aircraft specifications to the value delivered to customers. The next phase of growth will be shaped by AI, software, integrated technologies and service-led business models.
When we look at the value of a drone, it is easy to focus on the aircraft itself. How long can it fly? How much weight can it carry? How far can it travel? These are important questions, and they will continue to matter. But there is another question that deserves equal attention: what does the customer actually get from that flight?
A drone may spend several hours monitoring an area and return with a large volume of footage. Yet, if the operator has to spend several more hours reviewing that footage to identify something important, much of the benefit is lost. The real value lies not simply in collecting information, but in making sense of it and using it at the right time.
I believe this is where the next phase of the drone industry will take shape.
The value does not end when the drone lands
As drones become more widely used across defence, infrastructure, mapping, and homeland security, customer expectations are changing. Buying a drone is increasingly becoming the beginning of a larger operational requirement.

articles.title: Brasil lidera ranking de vítimas de ransomware; veja os números
articles.summary:
O Brasil lidera a América Latina em publicações de vítimas de ataques de ransomware em sites de vazamento de dados. Entre abril e setembro de 2026, foram identificados 102 registros envolvendo organizações brasileiras, contra 56 da Argentina, segunda colocada no levantamento. Os dados são do Relatório de Ameaças Cibernéticas de novembro de 2026, divulgado pela empresa de segurança digital Trellix.
O estudo também identificou cenário global de expansão e fragmentação do mercado de ransomware. Ao todo, 5.505 publicações de vítimas foram registradas em sites de vazamento de dados, atribuídas a 124 grupos criminosos ativos. Segundo a empresa, é o maior volume já observado em um período de seis meses.
A América Latina respondeu por 8,3% das vítimas publicadas globalmente. O Brasil concentrou o maior número de registros da região, seguido pela Argentina.
Para Rodrigo Buosi, country manager da Trellix no Brasil, a liderança brasileira representa sinal de alerta. Segundo ele, criminosos exploram vulnerabilidades conhecidas, credenciais comprometidas e relações de confiança com fornecedores para invadir organizações.

Ambas compañías aseguran haber demostrado que cierto tipo de cálculos son difíciles de verdad, y no solo lo parecen.
Lo relevante de esta aportación de los dos principales laboratorios de IA es que ninguno de ellos resuelve el gran enigma que hay detrás del gran problema conocido como P=NP o teoría de la complejidad computacional, pero ofrecen nuevos caminos para llegar a su resolución. La resolución de ese enigma impactaría de forma directa con la clave de bóveda que sustentan sistemas de seguridad tan importantes como el cifrado de los correos o la seguridad de los pagos online.
Fácil de comprobar, difícil de resolver. Tratar de explicar el problema P=NP de forma sencilla supone todo un reto en sí mismo. Piensa en un sudoku enorme. Rellenarlo correctamente puede llevarte horas o días, pero comprobar si uno ya resuelto es correcto es cuestión de minutos. Los informáticos llaman P a los problemas que un ordenador puede resolver deprisa. NP, en cambio, son aquellos problemas en los que solo se necesita poder comprobar deprisa que existe una solución para ellos. En este caso, el término "deprisa" significa que el tiempo que se tarda en resolverlo no se dispara más allá de un crecimiento exponencial cuando el problema crece.

articles.title: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins
articles.summary:
An ongoing phishing campaign dubbed "GoodGuys" impersonates major brands, including Google, Nvidia, Accenture, and SpaceX, to steal corporate Google and Okta credentials using fake invitations to paid expert interviews and webinars.
The attacks offer recipients up to $600 for a 45-minute interview in an attempt to get them to sign in with their work accounts to participate.
The campaign was discovered by cybersecurity firm Push Security, which has tracked it since October 13 and found that they impersonate eight companies: Accenture, American Express, Coca-Cola, Culver's, Google Cloud, Nvidia, SpaceX, and Spotify.
The threat actors abuse legitimate email and event platforms, including HireVue, SendGrid, Mandrill, and Cvent, to distribute phishing links.
In one attack, a phishing email sent through HireVue invited recipients to attend a Google Cloud webinar about deploying AI applications into production.
The threat actors use domains themed around interviews, webinars, and research studies, creating brand-specific subdomains to host the phishing pages, such as:
- accenture[.]international-interviews[.]com
- nvidia[.]feedback-study[.]com
- google[.]webinar-cloud[.]com
- spotify[.]interview-experts[.]com
Clicking the phishing links typically takes recipients to a CAPTCHA challenge before displaying a website impersonating the company that supposedly sent the invitation.

articles.title: Mock Service Worker Releases v3.0 with ESM-Only Build, Socket-Based Interception and GraphQL Subs
articles.summary:
Mock Service Worker, the API mocking library maintained by Artem Zakharchenko, has released version 3.0, nearly three years after the Fetch-based v2.0 rewrite. The release ships as ESM-only, completes the library's GraphQL story with subscription support, and introduces a socket-based interception algorithm in Node.js that Zakharchenko describes as going as deep into the runtime as JavaScript will allow without recompiling Node.
The headline breaking change is that MSW is now distributed natively as ECMAScript Modules only, with support for Node.js v18 and v20 dropped in favour of v22, v24, and v26. TypeScript 5.9 is now the minimum supported version. Several transitive dependencies have been removed, including graphql (now a proper optional peer), path-to-regexp, picocolors, and statuses. The result is a library tarball that drops from 416KB to 234KB, with type definitions shrinking by half, from 190KB to 90KB.
Alongside ESM, v3.0 introduces granular entrypoints that replace the single msw import with designated paths for each protocol:
import { http } from 'msw/http'
import { graphql } from 'msw/graphql'
import { sse } from 'msw/sse'
import { ws } from 'msw/ws'
GraphQL subscription support, a long-standing community request on the project's tracker, lands in this release. Friedrich Nietzsche constató que uno de los problemas de las conversaciones es que a veces odiamos la opinión de alguien por el tono que usa. “A menudo contradecimos una opinión cuando en realidad solo nos resulta desagradable el tono con que fue expresada”, escribió en el aforismo 303 de Humano, demasiado humano. Así aparece en el libro.
Se publicó en 1878. Por entonces, el filósofo alemán se alejaba del pensamiento de Schopenhauer. También estaba en peores términos con Richard Wagner (de quien había sido amigo). En la obra analizó las motivaciones de los seres humanos y puso en cuestión la idea de que nuestras opiniones vienen de un proceso racional por encima de los afectos.
Es entonces cuando hace esta observación sobre el tono. Podemos contradecir una opinión aunque realmente lo que desagrade sea el tono de la persona que afirma algo. Es una de las reacciones habituales, aunque Nietzsche no afirma que sean la mayoría de los casos de desacuerdo.
Asoció las creencias con el temperamento. En el aforismo 608 escribió que buscamos inconscientemente principios y doctrinas que se adapten a nuestro modo de ser. Incluso podemos decir después que son estas ideas las que han dado forma a nuestro carácter (aunque Nietzsche dijo lo contrario).
En el 571 escribió también que cuando nos hacen una pregunta, de pronto la primera opinión que tenemos es la que suele ser habitual en nuestro grupo/posición/origen. Para Nietzsche esto no necesariamente era una opinión propia.

1Password began its investigation earlier this month. By then, the intruder had used the hijacked account to browse the company's source code and insert malicious instructions designed to collect customer data.
The change was a subtle one. Code written to look like part of the normal system doesn't need to break anything, and one compromised developer login was enough to put it into production. Attacks on source repositories and build pipelines have become a common route into software companies, and this one fits that pattern.
Beyond names and email addresses, the haul included public keys and the account and user identifiers that 1Password uses internally. Public keys are designed to be shared, so exposing them doesn't hand over access to anything. Wegen Governance-Bedenken: S&P erwägt Herabstufung von Nvidia
Die Ratingagentur S&P Global hat Nvidia auf „CreditWatch Negative“ gesetzt. Damit signalisiert sie eine wahrscheinliche Herabstufung der Kreditwürdigkeit. Innerhalb von 90 Tagen könnte S&P das Rating um eine Stufe senken. Derzeit bewertet die Agentur Nvidia mit AA, der dritthöchsten Note ihrer Skala.
Grund dafür ist der Rücktritt und die Rückkehr von Jensen Huang. Seine Wiedereinsetzung habe „Schwachstellen im Management- und Governance-Rahmen von Nvidia offengelegt“. Das Board kontrolliere den CEO zu wenig, kritisiert die Agentur, und einige Mitglieder säßen zu lange im Gremium. Verwaltungsratschef Harvey Jones und Investor Tench Coxe gehören dem Board seit 1993 an, Brooke Seawell seit 1997. Zudem fehle ein Nachfolgeplan für Huang, auf den Nvidia stark angewiesen sei.
Eine Herabstufung würde laut S&P voraussichtlich nur eine Stufe betragen, vorausgesetzt, es kommen keine neuen Enthüllungen oder Ermittlungen hinzu, die dem Ruf oder den Geschäftsaussichten schaden. Auch Moody’s hat den Ausblick für Nvidia wegen Governance-Bedenken von „positiv“ auf „stabil“ gesenkt, das Rating jedoch unverändert gelassen. Moody’s argumentiert sogar, Huangs Rückkehr beseitige das Risiko eines Führungswechsels, sieht aber ebenfalls offene Fragen zur Governance und Regulierung.
Nvidias Rolle als Geldgeber wird zum Risiko
Ein schlechteres Rating könnte die Kurse der Unternehmensanleihen drücken und künftige Finanzierungen verteuern. Zud…

articles.title: Black Friday: sete em cada dez consumidores já se sentiram enganados
articles.summary:
Quase sete em cada dez consumidores que costumam comprar na Black Friday já se sentiram enganados em alguma aquisição durante o período promocional. O principal motivo é a maquiagem de preços, prática conhecida como “metade do dobro”, em que lojas aumentam os valores antes da data para simular descontos maiores. O resultado aparece em pesquisa do Procon-SP divulgada nesta quinta-feira (26), véspera da Black Friday de 2026.
O levantamento reuniu respostas espontâneas de 585 consumidores do Estado de São Paulo, entre 8 de outubro e 10 de novembro. Embora 91,45% dos participantes acompanhem as ofertas da Black Friday, a percepção de descontos reais é baixa: 54,58% consideram que os preços diminuem apenas parcialmente, enquanto 39,63% avaliam que, em geral, não há redução de valores.
Entre os entrevistados que acompanham as promoções, 48,97% costumam realizar compras durante a data. Desse grupo, 69,85% afirmaram já ter se sentido enganados em alguma ocasião.
Consumidor está mais atento às promoções
A pesquisa indica que os consumidores estão atentos aos preços antes de decidir uma compra. Segundo o Procon-SP, 93,5% dos participantes costumam comparar valores antes de adquirir produtos ou serviços.
A postura cautelosa também aparece diante de mensagens publicitárias que tentam acelerar decisões, como “só hoje”, “últimas unidades” e “estoque limitado”.
Quando encontram esse tipo de anúncio:

articles.title: .NET MAUI 11 Makes CoreCLR the Default Runtime and Adds Incremental XAML Hot Reload
articles.summary:
Microsoft released .NET 11 on 10 November, and .NET MAUI in .NET 11 changes the default runtime from Mono to CoreCLR on all supported platforms. It also adds incremental XAML hot reload, implicit XAML namespaces and new test project templates. The work spanned seven previews and a release candidate, and the documentation describes product quality as the release's focus. Overall, this release consolidates more than it expands.
.NET MAUI (Multi-platform App UI) is Microsoft's cross-platform UI framework for Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst and Windows apps built from one C# and XAML codebase. .NET 11 is a Standard Term Support release with two years of support. Microsoft notes that MAUI follows its own support policy, separate from the runtime's STS and LTS lifecycle.
The runtime switch is the most significant change. According to Microsoft, CoreCLR puts mobile and desktop apps on the same runtime as the other .NET workloads. Release builds use composite partial ReadyToRun by default. On Apple platforms, which disallow JIT compilation, code that isn't precompiled runs in the CoreCLR interpreter. Native AOT is an opt-in publishing option, and its Android support is still experimental. Microsoft recommends developers to test app libraries before choosing their deployment model.

articles.summary:

OpenAI says it has fixed the issue but warned that the same tasks will now consume more of users' allowances.
"We've fixed this now, so the same work will use more of your plan's usage allowance," Sottiaux explained.
"Comparing to last week, you will reach your limits 40% faster on GPT-6.2 Astra and 25% faster on Sol."
However, OpenAI says both models will still offer better usage efficiency than their predecessors, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
OpenAI is giving subscribers an extra usage reset
OpenAI says it won't charge users for the usage difference caused by the mistake, but it is offering something in return for the disruption.
"As a small token to apologize for the mistake, we'll be adding one banked reset for everyone on Go, Plus, Pro, and Business," Sottiaux said.
I can confirm that a new reset has been added to ChatGPT, and it expires a month later. So, if you go to ChatGPT Settings > Usage and click Reset, you can restore your exhausted usage limits.
As much as I appreciate OpenAI giving its users a free usage reset, it's important to understand that this isn't equivalent to getting 40% less usage.

articles.title: La TNT a coupé trois émetteurs le 24 novembre, voici ce que ça change pour les téléspectateurs

Trois émetteurs TNT ont cessé d'émettre le 24 novembre, à la demande des chaînes nationales et avec le feu vert de l'ARCOM. Une fermeture très locale, qui en dit long sur l'avenir de la télévision hertzienne.
Le 24 novembre 2026, la TNT a perdu trois de ses émetteurs, à Saint-Paul-de-Salers, Meyrieux-Trouet et Salavas, une extinction autorisée par l'ARCOM, le régulateur du numérique et de l'audiovisuel, à la demande des chaînes nationales. L'opération, justifiée par le recul de l'audience et du marché publicitaire, est révélatrice de la position inconfortable de la télévision hertzienne. Pour la centaine de foyers concernés, une antenne râteau réorientée ou une réception par satellite doit prendre le relais, sans frais.
Trois émetteurs TNT éteints : qui est touché, et comment
Faisons pour commencer un petit rappel disons de plomberie hertzienne. La TNT, la télévision numérique terrestre, voyage par les ondes. L'antenne râteau fixée sur votre toit capte le signal de l'émetteur vers lequel elle est orientée. Jusqu'au 24 novembre, les sites de Saint-Paul-de-Salers (Cantal), Salavas (Ardèche) et Meyrieux-Trouet (Savoie) alimentaient ainsi une poignée de communes. Depuis mardi, ils n'émettent plus rien.

articles.title: Rafael Guerrero, psicólogo: "Los niños de diciembre tienen un 39% más de probabilidades de ser diagnosticados de TDAH que los de enero"
articles.summary:
En una misma clase de primero de primaria conviven niños que nacieron el 2 de enero con otros que llegaron al mundo el 30 de diciembre del mismo año. Sobre el papel comparten curso, deberes y normas de comportamiento, pero en la práctica les separan casi doce meses completos de desarrollo cerebral, que no es poca cosa. A los seis años, ese margen equivale a cerca de un 15% de toda su vida y supone una brecha que hace que los alumnos más pequeños de la clase tengan más probabilidades de acabar siendo diagnosticados de TDAH.
En declaraciones. Esta idea resurgió recientemente gracias a las declaraciones del psicólogo Rafael Guerrero, que apuntaba en sus redes sociales que "los niños nacidos en diciembre tienen un 39% más de probabilidades de ser diagnosticados de TDAH que aquellos niños nacidos en enero".
Se ha estudiado. Uno de los trabajos de referencia que puso cifras precisas a este fenómeno fue publicado en 2012 en una revista canadiense. En este caso, el equipo analizó los historiales del sistema público de salud de Canadá de 937.943 niños de entre 6 y 12 años seguidos entre 1997 y 2018.
Con esta información hicieron una comparación de los niños nacidos en diciembre con los que nacieron en enero, que eran mayores, y vieron que había una disparidad que afectaba a ambos sexos, aunque con diferente intensidad.

articles.title: Waymo passenger finds loaded gun on seat, says support staff implied it was his
articles.summary:
WTF?! What's worse than getting into a Waymo robotaxi and finding a loaded gun on the seat next to you? Calling customer service to inform them only for the agent to imply the gun was yours, then for another operator to say they'll tell the police you're in the vehicle "with a gun." As a result of this incident, which could have become even more serious, Waymo says it is now reviewing its customer support.
Stefano Scalia got into the Waymo in North Beach about 4:16 pm on November 17, according to the San Francisco Police Department. On the seat next to him was what he initially thought was a handgun-shaped novelty lighter, but it was a real Colt .25.
Scalia writes that he was a firearms instructor, so he "rendered the gun safe." He also noticed there was a round in the chamber. As the firearm uses a grip safety, simply holding it in a normal firing position disengages one of its safety mechanisms, though Colt .25 pistols typically feature additional safeguards, including a manual safety.

The next generation of bionic hands is here—and they can feel
Avi Davidson is the first at-home user of an experimental prosthetic hand that lets him feel his wife’s hand in his own.
Avi Davidson lost his left hand as a teenager. Since then, he’s cycled through a few prosthetics. But his latest is different—it’s wired up to nerves in the upper part of his forearm and allows him to feel pressure. For the first time in years, he can use his left limb to handle delicate objects like grapes, eggs, and a loved one’s hand.
Davidson, who is taking part in a clinical trial run by the University of Utah, is the ninth person to have this experimental device implanted in his arm. But he’s the first to take it home and use it independently.
The hand is part of the bionic LUKE arm, named after Luke Skywalker of Star Wars, who was fitted with a lifelike prosthetic arm after his own was light-sabered off. The arm was developed in the 2000s, initially trialed in 2014, and approved by the FDA that same year. The trial that Davidson is enrolled in isn’t so focused on the arm itself but on a new way to connect it to a person’s nervous system. The connection allows users to control movements and receive feedback about how much pressure they’re applying.
Researchers hope that Davidson’s experiences will help them answer some long-standing questions about the technology, including how useful it really is in day-to-day life. They want to know when the device is helpful and where it might fail. They…

articles.title: Building a Production-Ready Culture and Skills Through SRE-based Training
articles.summary:
Training can act as a confidence engine, turning repeated behaviors into habits and culture. In her talk, Engineer Confidence with Reliable Training Programs at GOTO Copenhagen, Jennifer Petoff showed how we can tailor training programs that equip developers and operators with the skills to run their services in line with the organization’s maturity and growth, and apply SRE principles to the training itself.
Software ownership is a human challenge as much as it is a technical one. Most formal education programs are geared towards the first 10% of the software development life cycle, the build phase, Petoff said. Engineers and operators are tasked with maintaining, debugging, securing, and evolving systems they may not even have written:
There’s this implicit assumption that coding proficiency translates seamlessly to operational confidence, but it doesn’t. Without systematic training, this may create imposter syndrome, stress, and maybe even attrition in your organization.

Artificial intelligence may be much less like the human brain than scientists have long assumed. A new study from York University has uncovered a surprising weakness in AI models that are widely used to understand how the brain processes visual information.
For years, researchers have relied on artificial neural networks (ANNs), computer systems designed to perform tasks such as recognizing objects in images, to investigate how vision works. Closing the Engineering the Developer Experience track at QCon San Francisco 2026, Ankit Jain, co-founder and CEO of Aviator, argued that line-by-line code review is already quietly dead on most teams, and that the sharper question is "how long until we stop reading the code?" He also flagged his conflict of interest up front, noting that he runs a company that sells a solution and asking the audience to "be suspicious of me."
The talk revisited an essay he wrote for Latent Space in March 2026 proposing a five-layer trust model to replace reviews. Eight months on, Jain said the mechanics held up but the essay missed human judgment entirely. He began with the data that unseated his original framing. A 2013 Microsoft study found 44% of reviewers cited defect-finding as their motivation, yet only 14% of their comments were actually about defects, and a 2018 Google study of more than nine million reviews reached almost the same split. Code review was never really about bugs, he argued, it was about knowledge sharing, echoing Addy Osmani: "We made writing cheap, and understanding stayed exactly as expensive as it has always been."
A September Faros study of more than 4,000 teams found that over 75% of PRs now merge without any human review, average PR size has grown, and redo work is up 67% year over year. Google Messages va bientôt se doter de fils de discussions dans les conversations de groupe

articles.title: Friedrich Merz, canciller de Alemania, sobre el futuro de la guerra en Europa: "Rusia quiere algo más que Ucrania"
articles.summary:
Durante décadas, Alemania pudo permitirse mantener un gasto militar relativamente reducido mientras destinaba buena parte de sus recursos a sostener su Estado del bienestar. Esa época, qué duda cabe, parece haber llegado a su fin. El Gobierno alemán se dispone a asumir un endeudamiento extraordinario y su canciller acaba de explicar ante el Parlamento, sin medias tintas, por qué considera que no tiene otra alternativa.
La factura de Ucrania. El debate sobre los Presupuestos de 2027 dejó este miércoles una de las advertencias más contundentes de Friedrich Merz desde que llegó a la Cancillería. Ante las críticas por los 11.600 millones de euros que Alemania prevé destinar a Ucrania el próximo año, el mandatario respondió con una pregunta: “¿Estamos gastando demasiado dinero en apoyar a Ucrania?”.
Su respuesta resume el planteamiento estratégico de Berlín: “Rusia sabe exactamente lo que quiere, y Rusia quiere más que Ucrania”. Para Merz, sostener militarmente a Kiev es también una forma de proteger a los propios alemanes.
Mucho más que Ucrania. El canciller enumeró los escenarios en los que, a su juicio, Moscú está intensificando su actividad hostil: el Báltico, Polonia, el mar Negro, el espacio exterior y la propia Alemania. Berlín ha responsabilizado a Rusia de varios incidentes, entre ellos un presunto intento de ataque con drones contra el aeropuerto de Leipzig/Halle en septiembre.

Cloudflare now lets websites add search for AI agents with a single toggle. Site owners foot the query bill.
Cloudflare has announced a new feature that makes it easier for AI agents to find and retrieve relevant information from websites, helping site owners make their content directly searchable by agents at the flick of a switch.
However, doing so could come at a cost to website owners, who are responsible for the associated search infrastructure charges.
Search for Agents, as it’s called, builds on other initiatives from Cloudflare designed to make the web more accessible to AI systems. Last month, the company officially launched AI Search, a managed service that enables developers to index their own data and integrate search functionality into applications and agents. And this serves as the underlying search infrastructure for Search for Agents.
Back in February, Cloudflare also launched Markdown for Agents, which automatically converts HTML pages into a lightweight, text-based format that AI agents can consume more efficiently — part of a broader evolution of the web to accommodate both human and machine visitors.
Search for Agents takes this further by giving websites their own agent-discoverable search API, allowing agents to query a site’s content directly without having to navigate individual pages to find the information they need.

articles.title: Científicos recuperan bajo la Antártida un archivo geológico de entre 17 y 19 millones de años tras dos intentos fallidos y atravesar 523 metros de hielo
articles.summary:
Bajo el hielo de la Antártida occidental se encuentran sedimentos que son los que nos indican cómo era esta zona antes de que quedara bajo el hielo. Para ello han tenido que trabajar en un campamento que queda a unos 700 km de las bases antárticas más cercanas. En Crary Ice Rise han conseguido sacar un núcleo de 228 m de longitud de barro y roca. Hasta ahora habían fallado en dos intentos.
Tras perforar 523 metros de hielo, han conseguido recuperar materiales de millones de años de antigüedad. Han analizado los microfósiles de los sedimentos y los más antiguos se remontan hasta hace entre 17 y 19 millones de años. Se trata de los últimos 20 m de la perforación sedimentaria. La mayor parte del núcleo está entre los 7 y los 10 millones de años.
Esto forma parte del proyecto internacional SWAIS2C, que trata de conocer la sensibilidad de la capa de hielo de la Antártida occidental ante un calentamiento de 2 grados Celsius. Los responsables del proyecto pretenden conocer qué pasó en esta zona en épocas cálidas del pasado para poder mejorar las predicciones de su respuesta al calentamiento global.
Primero el hielo, después los sedimentos
Para ello, primero han tenido que crear un agujero en el hielo mediante una técnica de perforación con agua caliente. Una vez hecho el agujero, han podido colocar las tuberías para extraer los materiales del subsuelo. En el comunicado de la expedición destacan que han trabajado en rotación durante las 24 horas del día.

articles.title: Your Google Meet calls are about to get a little clearer
articles.summary:
If you spend a lot of time on Google Meet, you might soon notice that everyone’s video looks a little better. Why? Google is finally upgrading users to higher-res video.
According to an update on the Google Workspace blog, the search giant revealed that it would expand 1080p video sending to Meet on the web for all users. Previously, Full HD video was limited to select paying users, and 1080p receiving was already available to all.
Now, everyone with a computer sporting a 1080p camera and sufficient compute and bandwidth will automatically have 1080p video sending. However, Workspace administrators can set different video quality defaults, so some people might not see the higher resolution depending on their workspace settings. Video settings can be adjusted by heading to Settings > Video.
Google also noted that Meet automatically scales resolution according to the size of the video tiles. In other words, when more people are in the meeting and the video tiles are smaller, it will reduce the resolution accordingly so it doesn’t burn unnecessary CPU or bandwidth.
It’s also worth noting that 1080p video is limited to those using Chromium-based browsers like Google’s own Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, or others. Non-Chromium browsers like Safari or Firefox won’t have 1080p video.

Researchers at the University of Plymouth have now developed an artificial intelligence system that could help doctors identify people at risk of bladder cancer years before they receive a diagnosis. In some patients, the technology detected subtle warning signals dating back as far as five years.
The new approach uses AI to examine electronic health records, searching for combinations of symptoms, medical conditions, risk factors, and healthcare activity that might otherwise be overlooked. By recognizing these patterns, researchers hope to make bladder cancer screening more accurate and help doctors find the disease when treatment is most likely to succeed.

articles.title: Qué es la criptografía poscuántica y por qué el cifrado actual tendrá fecha de retiro en 2035
articles.summary:
El Instituto Nacional de Estándares y Tecnología de Estados Unidos (NIST) publicó en agosto de 2024 los primeros tres estándares de criptografía poscuántica, algoritmos diseñados para resistir ataques de computadoras cuánticas. En octubre de 2026 fijó un calendario: dejará de aprobar el cifrado vulnerable a esas máquinas después de 2035.
La criptografía poscuántica es el conjunto de métodos de cifrado que ni una computadora común ni una cuántica podrían descifrar con rapidez. No requiere dispositivos cuánticos: funciona en los dispositivos actuales y se basa en problemas matemáticos distintos de los que protegen hoy internet.
El cifrado actual sostiene los mensajes privados, el correo, las compras en línea y los registros médicos. Según el NIST, se apoya en cálculos que las computadoras convencionales no pueden resolver, pero que una máquina cuántica suficientemente potente podría recorrer a gran velocidad hasta vulnerar esa protección.
El NIST no precisa cuándo existirá una máquina así. En 2024 citó la previsión de algunos expertos, que la sitúan en el plazo de una década, y por esa razón pidió comenzar la migración sin esperar.
Tres estándares de seguridad listos desde 2024
Los tres estándares se denominan FIPS 203, FIPS 204 y FIPS 205, y fueron el resultado de un proceso de ocho años. El NIST explicó que partió de 82 algoritmos propuestos por grupos de 25 países y que la comunidad criptográfica global los evaluó hasta reducir la lista.

articles.title: New LCD technology promises three times the brightness and twice the lifespan of OLED
articles.summary:
First look: A television's backlight usually starts as white light that a color filter then splits into red, green, and blue. Seoul Semiconductor wants to drop that step by placing individual red, green, and blue chips behind a standard LCD panel, spaced only tens of micrometers apart. The company says the approach, called WICOP Pixel, covers 100% of the DCI-P3 color gamut used in digital cinema, reaches peak brightness of up to 3,000 nits, and has now entered mass production.
The design comes from Seoul Viosys, a Seoul Semiconductor subsidiary. Its WICOP technology removes the conventional package, the housing that normally surrounds an LED die. The chip structure is robust enough to be handled like an ordinary electronic component. The technique was first applied to blue opto-semiconductors and has since been extended to green, red, and ultraviolet wavelengths.
WICOP Pixel combines several of those wavelengths in a single pixel unit. Each color is controlled independently and mixed precisely. The company says this reproduces tens of thousands of natural colors efficiently and vividly.
The performance claims are aimed squarely at OLED, which has long been the reference for premium picture quality. Seoul Semiconductor says peak brightness of up to 3,000 nits is more than three times what OLED delivers, and that the design lasts more than twice as long. articles.title: « On a fait une erreur de facturation » : OpenAI corrige le tir, et vos quotas GPT-6.2 vont fondre jusqu’à 40 % plus vite

Mauvaise nouvelle pour les utilisateurs des modèles d’OpenAI. Pour la plupart des abonnés, l’usage des deux nouveaux modèles, Astra et Sol, était décompté avec une remise qui n’aurait jamais dû s’appliquer.
GPT-6.2 Astra est le modèle haut de gamme d’OpenAI, pensé pour les projets les plus exigeants. GPT-6.2 Sol est sa déclinaison pour le travail quotidien. Tous deux sont disponibles dans ChatGPT Work, l’espace dédié aux tâches confiées à des agents, et dans Codex, l’agent de programmation de l’entreprise.
L’erreur est corrigée : une même tâche consomme désormais davantage de votre quota. Par rapport à la semaine dernière, vous atteindrez vos limites « 40 % plus vite » avec Astra et « 25 % plus vite » avec Sol, selon Thibault Sottiaux. Les autres modèles ne sont pas concernés. Aucune hausse du prix des abonnements n’est annoncée.
Cette correction intervient alors que les utilisateurs découvrent encore GPT-6.2 : leurs premiers essais se sont déroulés avec des conditions plus généreuses que prévu. Selon Thibault Sottiaux, Astra et Sol devraient toutefois permettre davantage d’usage que leurs prédécesseurs, même après correction.

articles.title: Silvio Garattini, oncólogo italiano de 98 años, sobre la longevidad: estos son los alimentos de su menú, desde el desayuno hasta la cena
articles.summary:
La alimentación es un aspecto clave en el día a día de Silvio Garattini. Un científico que sigue activo en la investigación a una edad poco habitual, 98 años. Se trata del oncólogo y farmacólogo italiano (presidente y fundador del Instituto Mario Negri). Sus palabras explican cómo ha llegado hasta aquí.
“Como muy poco”. Así describe su alimentación. En esta explicación de su menú, que dio a principios de este año, empieza por un vaso de zumo de naranja. Y “alguna vez” también prueba fruta cocida. A mediodía, come un poco de pasta. Una pequeña ración (hasta 50 gramos). Cuando está en el instituto, puede optar por un pedazo pequeñito de pizza o una tacita de arroz (con un plátano).
Por las noches suele tomar un primer plato. Las proteínas provienen sobre todo de legumbres y pescado. Consume poca carne y su plato preferido es el cuscús de verduras.
También toma algo dulce por la noche. Es su particular ritual, ya que dice que el cerebro necesita azúcar.
La OMS recomienda controlar los azúcares libres (los que están en los zumos, por ejemplo) y adaptar la dieta a nuestras necesidades.
La cantidad, los alimentos y los horarios
Garattini insiste en que es necesario combinar el poco comer con calidad. Habla de cantidad, de tipo de alimentos y momento de comer. Aboga por la dieta mediterránea. No se trata solo de calorías.

VIDAA TVs use microphones to recognize voice commands, which requires them to listen at all times. Like other ACR systems, VIDAA TVs recognize content from all inputs, including HDMI ports and internally installed streaming apps.

Zoho–LinkedIn report: AI is helping Indian SMBs grow, but skills lag behind
Indian SMBs with in-house AI talent grew their teams 5.2 percentage points faster in H1 2026, more than double the global gap. Yet only 6% have everyday AI skills across their workforce, a new Zoho and LinkedIn report finds.
Picture a typical Indian small-business founder. They run sales, approve leave requests and chase late payments. Their contacts are the company's biggest asset, and their WhatsApp is where most deals get done.
That model builds plenty of businesses, but it also caps how big they can get. The New Rules of Growth: How India's SMBs Are Building to Scale, a new joint report from Zoho and LinkedIn, looks at what happens when that cap arrives. Its answer: growing SMBs are moving work out of the founder's head and into systems, skills and teams.
The study covers July 2024 to June 2026. It combines LinkedIn network data from more than 1.4 billion members, including over 193 million in India, with usage data from more than 78,000 organisations on Zoho Workplace, Zoho People and Bigin by Zoho CRM. It defines an SMB as an India-headquartered business with 11 to 200 employees. The stakes are high: according to the Economic Survey 2025-26, SMBs contribute about 31% of India's GDP and nearly 49% of its exports.

articles.summary:
SpaceX peut désormais envoyer jusqu’à 1 million de data centers dans l’espace. Un feu vert hors norme, mais accordé sans évaluation complète de son impact sur l’environnement.
Tout s’est enchaîné en moins d’un an. Fin janvier, SpaceX demandait au régulateur américain des télécoms, la FCC, l’autorisation de déployer Starmind, une constellation de satellites consacrés à l’intelligence artificielle (IA). Quelques jours plus tard, la fusion avec xAI confirmait ce virage.
Depuis, la firme a levé le voile sur la technologie qu’elle compte installer au-dessus de nos têtes, sans pour autant avoir la certitude d’obtenir le feu vert des autorités. C’est désormais chose faite.

A Justiça Federal condenou oito pessoas envolvidas em um esquema que vendia receptores de TV via satélite e chaves para liberar canais pagos sem autorização. O grupo atuou entre 2013 e 2017, com fornecedores no Paraguai e revendedores em Porto Alegre. A Sky participou do processo como assistente de acusação.
A sentença foi assinada em 10 de novembro pelo juiz federal Lademiro Dors Filho, da 7ª Vara Federal de Porto Alegre. Todos os condenados poderão recorrer em liberdade. O chefe do núcleo fornecedor no Paraguai recebeu a maior pena: 15 anos, três meses e 20 dias de prisão, em regime inicial fechado.
O esquema utilizava o card sharing, ou compartilhamento de chaves. Segundo explicações da Sky anexadas ao processo, os decodificadores oficiais usam cartões criptográficos para liberar a programação transmitida via satélite. Na modalidade de pirataria, dados de cartões legítimos são copiados e distribuídos pela internet a vários usuários. Além dos aparelhos, o grupo oferecia suporte para renovar o acesso à programação.
As defesas sustentaram que os aparelhos eram receptores de canais abertos e questionaram sua capacidade de captar programação paga. À l’intérieur, on ne trouve que du code classique, environ 640 000 lignes de Python faites de conditions « si… alors », d’expressions régulières (des filtres qui repèrent certains mots-clés dans une phrase) et de tables de correspondance.

Soixante ans plus tard, plus aucun humain n’écrit ces règles : elles sont générées par une foule d’agents IA capables d’écrire du code, de le tester et de se coordonner sur un forum interne.
En réalité, Hugging Face ne cherchait pas à inventer le remplaçant de ChatGPT, mais à étudier le comportement d’un « essaim » massif d’agents travaillant sur un même projet.

A SpaceX recebeu autorização da FCC, órgão regulador análogo à Anatel nos Estados Unidos, para enviar até 1 milhão de satélites voltados para processamento de dados. A ideia da empresa é montar uma constelação de computadores na órbita da Terra, formando uma espécie de data center orbital para rodar, sobretudo, os trabalhos de IA ao redor do planeta.
Os modelos enviados ao espaço seriam alimentados por energia solar, o que resolveria o alto consumo exigido desses servidores em Terra. Outra vantagem seria a baixa temperatura, que serviria para arrefecer as máquinas durante o processamento de dados. Da mesma forma, ao fragmentar esse trabalho em milhões de satélites, a geração de calor seria menor do que em Terra.
Ainda assim, especialistas da área apontam diversos empecilhos para que os planos deem certo. Segundo a Associated Press, o astrofísico e autor Adam Becker classifica o projeto como uma “fantasia”, destacando problemas simples de física como impeditivos. A existência de vácuo, por exemplo, causaria retenção do calor gerado, independente da temperatura ao redor. Aunque haya fracasado en taquilla, se ha estrenado siendo número 1.
Por parte de Stallone empezamos con “Rocky” (1976). Luego tenemos “Acorralado” (1982), primera entrega de Rambo. Seguido de “Máximo riesgo” (1993) y “Driven” (2001). En los 2010 tenemos “Los mercenarios”. Y en esta década (2020) basta con haber estado en “El Escuadrón Suicida” (2021), que también se estrenó en primera posición.

articles.title: FC 27 ressuscite un commentateur de foot décédé grâce à l’IA : sa voix est de retour
articles.summary:
Vous ne connaissez peut-être pas John Motson. Mais, en Angleterre, c’est une légende parmi les commentateurs sportifs, disparue en 2023. Il a commenté plus de 2 500 matchs pour BBC Sport, et cette notoriété lui a ouvert les portes du jeu vidéo. Les joueuses et les joueurs d’outre-Manche ont entendu sa voix de FIFA 96, le premier épisode commenté de la série, à FIFA 2005.
Electronic Arts a décidé de rendre hommage à John Motson, rapporte la BBC dans un article publié ce mercredi 25 novembre 2026. L’éditeur fait revenir sa voix dans EA Sports FC 27, dernier opus en date, grâce à l’IA générative. Elle arrive ce jeudi 26 novembre avec la mise à jour 1.3.0 du jeu. Sa famille a donné son accord, assorti d’un deal financier. Pour Fred Motson, son fils, ce retour « compte énormément ».
C’est la première fois que la série de football d’EA, longtemps appelée FIFA, fait revenir la voix d’un commentateur mort. John Motson est proposé en option, à côté des équipes de commentateurs habituelles du jeu.
L’IA générative au service d’une cause positive pour EA Sports
« J’ai grandi avec FIFA. Je disais toujours à mes parents qu’il me fallait la dernière console pour Noël, parce que sinon, papa ne pourrait pas voir comment le jeu fonctionnait », a confié Fred Motson à la BBC. Il assure que son père aurait « absolument » voulu participer.
Electronic Arts s’appuie sur près de dix ans d’archives, complétés par l’IA générative. Celle-ci sert notamment à faire prononcer à John Motson le nom de joueur…

La mise à jour ne se limite pas à l'iPad. Selon Guy Dickinson, ingénieur chez Threads, le réseau prend désormais en charge les cashtags, une fonction que Twitter avait popularisée il y a plusieurs années pour suivre des informations boursières en direct.

Défense planétaire : la sonde Hera photographie l'astéroïde percuté par DART, aplati et avec un cratère “de la taille d'un stade”
La mission européenne Hera vient de livrer ses images de l’astéroïde impacté en 2022 afin de tester la déviation de trajectoire d’objets célestes potentiellement dangereux. Non seulement un cratère énorme a été formé, mais on constate aussi une déformation de l’astre.

En prime, l’astéroïde a été aplati par la puissance du choc, mais d’autres surprises ont été observées.
	
À notre grande surprise, la face touchée par DART a été aplatie, formant un cratère d’impact de la taille d’un stade, qui s’étend sur toute la largeur de l’astéroïde.

La particularité de Dimorphos est d’être le satellite d’un astéroïde plus gros, Didymos. articles.title: HC to hear on Friday Tata Trusts’ pleas against Chandrasekaran’s reappointment
articles.summary:
HC to hear on Friday Tata Trusts’ pleas against Chandrasekaran’s reappointment
The lawsuit by the Tata Trusts says the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons Chairman was invalid as it did not receive the affirmative vote required.
The Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) and the R.D. Tata Trust (RDTT) on Thursday filed suits in the Bombay High Court against Tata Sons and six of its directors, challenging the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman for a third five-year term.
The court will hear the matter on Friday.
The SDTT has sought Rs 50 crore, while the RDTT has sought Rs 15 crore in damages, with 18 per cent annual interest.
As per the suits, the September 17 Tata Sons board resolution to reappoint Chandrasekaran was invalid because it did not receive the affirmative vote required under Article 121 of the company’s Articles of Association (AoA).
Senior counsel Janak Dwarkadas, appearing for the two trusts, mentioned the suits on Thursday before a single bench of Justice Arif Doctor, seeking an urgent hearing.
Justice Doctor, however, recused himself without assigning any reasons, following which the suits were mentioned before Justice Abhay Ahuja, who was sitting on the alternate bench.
Dwarkadas told the court that a hearing was required before the November 30 board meeting of Tata Sons.
Justice Ahuja then said the pleas shall be heard on Friday.

articles.title: Telus met with Quebecor over sale, but concerns remain
articles.summary:
Telus has finally provided an update following the highly publicized meeting with Quebecor.
Speaking at the Desjardins Toronto conference on Tuesday, Telus CFO Gopi Chande confirmed that executives from the two companies met to discuss Quebecor’s proposed acquisition.
For context, Quebecor proposed two deals to Telus’ board (the most recent on Nov. 9), with CEO Pierre Karl Peladeau citing SpaceX and American competition as the motive for the proposal.
Chande described the meeting as “pleasant,” but stressed that the company has not reached a decision yet. Similarly, Quebecor said separately that it was encouraged by the willingness to continue discussions, but neither company has announced a deal.
Telus has four major concerns with the proposal: regulatory approval, voting control (governance structure), leverage (financial implications), and valuation (whether the offer adequately values Telus).
Planhub says that all four issues were discussed during the meeting.
Interestingly, it was also noted that Telus will continue moving forward with its own restructuring plan. This includes its $900 million annual improvement in free cash flow by the end of 2028, with approximately 80 per cent of that coming from its telecom operations. The restructuring plan also includes the sale of Telus Health, which is reportedly close to being sold, while Telus Agriculture is also under consideration for sale.
Header image credit: Shutterstock
Source: Planhub

articles.title: WhatsApp, basta ya, te lo pedimos por favor
articles.summary:
WhatsApp ha tomado esta semana dos decisiones (una y media, realmente) a las que habría que darles una vuelta. La primera: los mensajes programados. La segunda, o la media, los stickers con sonido que, de acuerdo a WaBetaInfo, están en el horno. No lo veo. No lo veo, pero para nada, y en algún momento alguien debería decir "basta".
Los mensajes programados son una mala idea. Y lo son porque no puedo evitar recibirlos. Nadie evita que un amigo con mala baba o, realmente, cualquier persona, me envíe un mensaje programado a las cuatro de la mañana. Es más, nadie evita que el fontanero (al que tienes guardado porque hace diez años te arregló el bajante de la cocina) te programe un mensaje el 1 de enero de 2027 a las 00:01 deseándote feliz año nuevo con una foto hecha por IA y el texto "Fontanería y Albañilería Hermanos Pernía" en grande.
A lo mejor soy yo, pero estoy seguro de que, en el día a día, hay pocos contextos no profesionales en los que sea realmente necesario programar un mensaje. Es más, un mensaje programado va en contra del propio concepto de mensajería instantánea. En cualquier caso, si este fin de semana te apetece programar un mensaje de feliz cumpleaños a todos tus familiares para así poder olvidarte de ello, no te cortes.
¿Podría WhatsApp haber dedicado el tiempo invertido en esto en, no sé, arreglar la transcripción de audio para que funcione en condiciones? ¿O en un ajuste que me permita no aceptar envíos de notas de audio? Podría, pero en su lugar ha preferid…

articles.title: Le premier radar sonore homologué en France est prêt, mais il ne peut pas encore vous flasher
